skips.name: Bit.StdbitH
skips.reason: <stdbit.h> (C++26) not provided by this standard library

skips.name: ConstantEvaluationRules.ConstexprCmath
skips.reason: std::fabs isn't constexpr in this library (no __cpp_lib_constexpr_cmath)

skips.name: ErroneousBehaviour.Gcc16ReadsZero
skips.reason: needs a compiler that implements erroneous behaviour (GCC 16)

skips.name: ExceptionHierarchy.OldUncaughtExceptionCantTellNestedScopes
skips.reason: std::uncaught_exception was removed in C++20 and this library no longer declares it

skips.name: Freestanding.FfreestandingFlag
skips.reason: needs a build with -ffreestanding; the suite builds hosted only (checked by hand: g++-15 and clang++ 22 -ffreestanding give __STDC_HOSTED__ 0)

skips.name: Functional.BindConstant
skips.reason: libc++ defines __cpp_lib_bind_front 202306L but lacks bind_front<f>() (the page says so)

skips.name: ImportStd.HeaderUnits
skips.reason: header units (import <vector>;): CMake doesn't support them (cmake-cxxmodules(7), Limitations); checked by tools/check_snippets.py instead

skips.name: Localization.DeDeGrouping
skips.reason: de_DE locale not available to this C++ library

skips.name: ObjectModel.MainFunction
skips.reason: gtest_main owns main(), so its implicit return and argv can't be observed here

skips.name: Print.RuntimeFormatWrapperSpelling
skips.reason: libc++ 22 has neither runtime_format nor dynamic_format

skips.name: ScopeStorageLinkage.Linkage
skips.reason: internal vs external linkage and the ODR are only observable across translation units
